text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Shuka Sho was truly a scorching-hot, 
fierce battle!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel it... Messiah-san's 
heartbeat—!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ah, haaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (...No, I won't back down!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaahhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She put her true strength on full display! 
Cesariooo—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Alright...! We did it, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However... my heart is still trembling. 
What was that...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: What on earth are you... doing?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I wanted... to win...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I wanted to win, aaah... aaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A roar of cheers envelops the racecourse. 
From adults to children, everyone pumped 
their fists in pure excitement at the 
Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stellar performances of Cesario and 
Air Messiah, in particular, became a major 
topic of discussion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on the way back that day, Cesario 
was unusually quiet.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Messiah-san today was simply too special.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"As we ran across the turf together— her 
brilliance took my breath away."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Just running alongside her makes my skin 
crawl with goosebumps and sets my heart 
ablaze...!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I felt an overwhelmingly captivating 
brilliance radiating strongly from 
Messiah-san.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't help but wonder about 
that—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Cesario's gaze, I saw Air 
Messiah surrounded by young Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah, that was aaaaamazing! You 
were so cool! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It was all glaring and sparkling~! 
My heart was beating sooooo fast!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: U-Um...! Th-Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, Daddy! I want to try racing too!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Then me too! I wanna run in the Shuka 
Sho too!

text_block_list.name: Father
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, is that so? ...Sounds wonderful. 
Why don't we consult Mom once we get home?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the children play, she smiled 
with a look of subtle exhilaration. Air 
Messiah in that moment left quite a 
lasting impression—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Cesario watched her with rapt attention.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. My apologies, it was just—such a 
shock.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Um... While it goes without saying, of 
course—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So a brilliance like that... is what 
inspires such longing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――A "radiance that inspires yearning." 
That is, without a doubt――

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
This is the indispensable 'Path'... 
'Sensei'—this is the 'radiance' essential 
for the foundation!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...what Cesario had dropped and lost this 
summer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Giving up on racing abroad... I had 
thought for the longest time that I had no 
choice but to seek another path.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Challenging the "Oaks" across three 
different countries— nothing could match 
the sheer scale of that ambition.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: However, that was not the case...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The stage had nothing to do with 
admiration; it was something born simply 
from having one's eyes captivated by the 
light before them—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Messiah-san achieved that very thing 
today……!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I—I know what I have to do now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having lost in the summer, blindly 
fumbling forward toward the future—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right now, a new light has been found...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...That said, I have no idea what kind of 
magic Messiah-san used this time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I had strong feelings riding on the Shuka 
Sho... That much is certain, but..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Could it really just be that, and nothing 
more?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...The mere fact that they're running in 
the 'Shuka Sho' means the other Umamusume 
are technically top-class."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, their obsession with victory is 
in a league of its own. Even if I don't 
know them personally, every single 
contender must be bringing that same 
burning intensity.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of all that, only Messiah-san 
radiated that brilliance—and undeniably 
captured the hearts of the children.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So... I am guessing there was something 
special about it, then?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...The answer is still...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Regardless, I'd like to ask for another 
chance to run with Messiah-san.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The next target will likely be the 
"Victoria Mile"— She will surely consider 
entering to claim the race that bears the 
name of that very queen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Victoria Mile is a Senior-class GⅠ 
race. Naturally, it draws massive 
attention from the public.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not only do I get to race against Air 
Messiah, but winning would also add 
prestige to my reputation as a 'teacher.'

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a new light was kindled in 
Cesario's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next target race is the Victoria Mile. 
I want to triumph in this fierce battle 
and take another step forward!
